classification.difficultyReason: Model cylinder capacity and divide by supplied daily rate, then interpret elapsed versus whole days.

content.prompt: A cylindrical water tank has diameter 4 m and a height of 2.5 m. If the tank is initially full, for how many days can a family use this water tank if their daily consumption of water is 600 litres? (Assume no water enters the tank during the time period.) Give the elapsed time to 2 decimal places.

answer.short: About 52.36 days; 52 complete days, with water running out during the 53rd day.
answer.worked: The radius is 2 m. $V=\pi(2)^2(2.5)=10\pi\text{ m}^3=10\,000\pi\text{ L}$. The duration is $10\,\frac{000\pi}{600}=\frac{50\pi}{3}\approx52.36$ days. Thus 52 complete days are possible and the tank runs out during day 53.
